topics.titleEn: What Is Gemini Live Guided Vision?
topics.angle: explainer: point your camera and get real-time step-by-step help
topics.brief: Outline: what Guided Vision adds to Gemini Live (real-time camera input plus spoken, step-by-step guidance); use cases (repairs, cooking, accessibility, shopping); how it differs from plain image Q&A; device support and the late-September-to-early-October 2026 rollout; the privacy implications of streaming live video to an assistant. Verify the feature scope and rollout window. Sources: https://blog.google/ (Gemini) and releasebot Gemini updates.

topics.titleTr: Akilli Gozluk ve Riza: Atladigimiz Gorgu Kurallari
topics.titleEn: Smart Glasses and Consent: The Etiquette We Skipped
topics.angle: contrarian: hardware raced ahead of the consent problem
topics.brief: Outline: the three-tier glasses market (AI camera eyewear, tethered AR, standalone AR computers); why always-on cameras break bystander consent; recording-indicator 'theater' vs real social norms; how laws lag the hardware; practical etiquette for wearers, hosts, and venues. Verify the AWE 2026 three tiers, the ~3.34M-to-32M unit forecast, and the rising consent concerns. Sources: https://www.abiresearch.com/blog/consumer-technology-trends-2026 and Next Reality's AWE 2026 coverage.

topics.titleTr: Artik Her Yerde RCS: SMS'in Sonu mu?
topics.titleEn: RCS Is Everywhere Now: The End of SMS?
topics.angle: explainer: what cross-platform RCS adoption means for you
topics.brief: Outline: what RCS adds over SMS (read receipts, typing indicators, high-res media, group features, encryption); the current iPhone-to-Android interop status; the rise of RCS Business Messaging (RBM) for brands; where plain SMS still wins (reliability, fallback); privacy and encryption caveats across platforms. Verify current RCS interop and end-to-end-encryption status across iOS and Android. Sources: GSMA RCS resources and Apple/Google messaging announcements.

topics.titleTr: Gemini Gems'leri 17 Kasim'dan Once Skills'e Tasi
topics.titleEn: Migrate Your Gemini Gems to Skills Before Nov 17
topics.angle: checklist: what changes, what breaks, and what to do before the cutover
topics.brief: Outline: the timeline (personal accounts from November 2026, with the app switch on Nov 17; Workspace business/enterprise March 2027; Education June 2027); what auto-migrates and what you must redo; the 100-active-skill cap; capabilities Skills don't yet support (GitHub files, Canvas, Deep Research, Guided Learning, create video/music); how slash-invoked, stackable skills change team workflows; an audit checklist. Verify the dates, the cap, and the unsupported-capability list. Sources: 'About the transition from Gems to skills' (support.google.com/gemini/answer/18560919) and TechCrunch's Gems-to-Skills report.

topics.titleTr: Siradaki Ise Alimin Bir Agent Olabilir: Karar Rehberi
topics.titleEn: Your Next Hire Might Be an Agent: A Decision Guide
topics.keywordTr: insan mi yapay zeka agent mi
topics.angle: decision guide for lean founders choosing between a hire and an agent
topics.brief: Outline: the 'team of three doing the work of ten' claim and where it holds; a decision framework (judgment, accountability, volume, risk, repeatability); tasks agents own well vs human-only work; the hidden costs of agents (oversight, error handling, tooling, drift); a staffing matrix; when you should still hire a person. Verify the lean-team/AI-agent productivity claims. Sources: https://waveup.com/blog/top-19-ai-tools-for-startups-and-small-businesses/ and https://blog.mean.ceo/bootstrapping-startup-trends-october-2026/.

topics.titleTr: Regule Alicilara Yapay Zeka Satmak: Kurucu Rehberi
topics.titleEn: Selling AI to Regulated Buyers: A Founder's Primer
topics.angle: guide: compliance, procurement and trust for B2G and regulated B2B
topics.brief: Outline: why regulated buyers (government, health, finance) are opening to AI now (e.g., FedRAMP High via Claude for Government); what they demand (audit logs, data residency, spend controls, human-in-the-loop, SOC 2); navigating long procurement cycles; how a small vendor positions on trust; building on a compliant platform vs reselling. Verify the Claude for Government FedRAMP High launch and its governance features. Sources: https://www.anthropic.com/news and https://www.infoq.com/articles/cloud-devops-trends-2026/ (sovereignty/compliance).
